result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. The main visual issue is horizontal truncation of the third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...'), which is cut off at the right edge with no visible scroll affordance or peek indicator. Other observations are minor cosmetic refinements.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right screen edge, with its title and image cut off mid-word and no clear visual cue that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial-card peek with consistent right padding and a subtle scroll indicator (e.g., gradient fade or dots) so users understand the row scrolls horizontally; ensure the card title truncates with an ellipsis rather than being cut mid-character.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') also runs off the right edge with a partially visible chip, lacking a scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same horizontal-scroll treatment with edge fade or padding so the cut-off chip reads as intentional and scrollable.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot badge with no text label or count, which may be unclear to screen-reader users and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and ensure the badge meets minimum touch-target and contrast guidelines.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('-20%') is cut off by the viewport with its restaurant name and metadata not visible, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for a scrolling feed, but ensure sufficient bottom padding above the tab bar so the next card's title peeks into view, signaling more content below.
